# GoodGround

> GoodGround is a website development studio in South Africa. We design and build custom, fast business websites, quoted as one fixed price with a choice of how to pay it: 50% upfront and 50% on completion, or 12 equal monthly instalments. Based in George, on the Garden Route, working with small and medium businesses across South Africa.

## What we do

- Website development: custom-built, fast websites made to grow with a business.
- UX and design: every page structured around how customers actually decide.
- SEO foundations: built to be found in South African search from launch.
- Website care plans: ongoing updates, support and performance after launch.

## How we price

Every project is one fixed price. Clients choose how to pay it: a 50% deposit to secure the project and the remaining 50% on completion, before handover, or 12 equal monthly instalments (the first instalment secures the booking, the remaining 11 become payable once the project is completed). Either way, it is not a subscription: once paid off, the website is fully owned by the client.
